subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support arbitrary deep or legacy Control UI prefixes without gateway.controlUi.basePath, or only root, known routes, /__openclaw__ public assets, and explicitly configured base paths?
rationale: Current source has partial fixes and tests that intentionally preserve 404s for arbitrary prefixed static assets, so another repair PR needs a maintainer URL-support decision first.

options.title: Support configured paths only
options.body: Keep arbitrary prefixed static assets as 404s and close or redirect remaining reports to documented root/configured-basePath usage.

options.title: Support arbitrary prefixes
options.body: Change the Vite, gateway, and UI asset contract so hard refreshes on legacy or unknown nested prefixes load the full Control UI safely.

options.title: Support selected legacy aliases
options.body: Add narrow compatibility only for known historical routes such as old connections URLs while leaving random prefixes unsupported.

recommendation.title: Support configured paths only
recommendation.body: Keep arbitrary prefixed static assets as 404s and close or redirect remaining reports to documented root/configured-basePath usage.

likelyOwner.reason: This is ultimately a gateway/static-asset URL contract decision, and his recent adjacent namespaced-asset work is the strongest routing signal among likely owners.
